title: Sand Garden
description: Pour sand, water, lava, seeds and fifteen other elements into a little world and watch them flow, grow, burn and react. A calm sandbox toy with no score and no way to lose.
controls: Mouse or finger: drag to draw, tap the buttons to pick an element and brush size. Keyboard: Space to pause, Z to undo, 1 to 5 for brush size, [ and ] to change element.
